result.summary: Independently re-verified REQ-027 (event cancellation notifies every non-withdrawn registrant, GitHub issue #30, depends_on REQ-026) at commit 943b8ae, branch feature/WF02-REQ-027. This is the last requirement of Phase 5. Did not trust TEST-RUNNER's Step 4 report, the test report yaml, or any prior gate's summary as a substitute for my own re-derivation. 1. Read docs/agents/design/REQ-027.md in full against all 5 ACs, then read the shipped diff directly (git diff master...HEAD --stat: 27 files, 2405 insertions -- domain/registration.ts's new selectNonWithdrawnRegistrantsForEvent, handlers/event.ts's new composeCancellationMessage/notifyNonWithdrawnRegistrants and makeEventCancelHandler's new sender parameter, i18n en/ru/types' new cancelledNotificationHeader key, index.ts's one-line notificationSender wiring, plus the design doc, test spec, ISS-0024, and this run's own handoffs/test-report) and confirmed it matches the design line-for-line: §2's SELECT (eventId match, admission != 'withdrawn', no time predicate, no evaluationTime param) confirmed by reading the actual `ne(registrations.admission, "withdrawn")` where-clause; §3's composeCancellationMessage re-fetch-and-skip-on-withdrawn table confirmed exactly; §3's notifyNonWithdrawnRegistrants single-snapshot-then-sequential-for-loop shape (no Promise.all) confirmed; §4's exact 3-line composed text (cancelledNotificationHeader / eventTitle / the pre-existing deepLinkSeeUpcoming, no new second key) confirmed; §5's call-site ordering (notifyNonWithdrawnRegistrants awaited AFTER cancelEvent returns, BEFORE the organizer's own ctx.reply) confirmed by reading handlers/event.ts:452-463 directly. Critically: `git diff master...HEAD -- apps/bot/src/domain/event.ts` returns EMPTY -- cancelEvent (REQ-016) has zero diff, genuinely untouched, its 'no registrations read, no notification' scope boundary preserved exactly as the design's §7/AC4 mapping claims. 2. Re-ran npm run lint myself: 0 errors, the same 2 pre-existing apps/web LCP warnings (Footer.tsx, Nav.tsx) unrelated to this diff. Re-ran npm run build myself: apps/web (Next.js/Turbopack) and apps/bot (tsc) both clean. Stood up my own scratch Postgres (apps/bot/docker-compose.yml, port 55432; container was already running from a prior session -- confirmed via `docker compose up -d` idempotent no-op), ran `DATABASE_URL=... npx drizzle-kit migrate` myself (applied cleanly), then `npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism` from the repo root: 25 files / 266 tests passed, 0 failed -- matches TEST-RUNNER's count exactly. 3. Independent re-verification with my own fresh fixture, never reusing BACKEND-DEV's/TEST-DESIGNER's/TEST-RUNNER's scratch scripts or their existing committed test files' exact counts: wrote and ran my own apps/bot/scratch-rv-req027.ts (deleted after use, git status confirmed clean) against the same scratch Postgres, calling notifyNonWithdrawnRegistrants directly (not through dispatch) with a distinct combination from every committed fixture -- 6 admitted / 4 waitlisted / 3 withdrawn (13 total registrations, none of which match the committed test file's 3/2/1 or the test-runner's 2/5/2 combinations). Result: exactly 10 sends (6+4), exactly 10 notification_ledger rows all matching the 10 non-withdrawn registrationIds, zero ledger rows for any of the 3 withdrawn registrants -- AC1 independently reproduced, PASS. AC4: captured the full 13-row registrations set (id+admission) BEFORE calling cancelEvent, captured it again AFTER both cancelEvent and notifyNonWithdrawnRegistrants completed, deep-compared both snapshots by value -- identical, same 13 rows, same admission values, zero drift -- AC4 independently reproduced, PASS. events.status confirmed 'cancelled' after the run. 4. Phase 5 coherence sanity check (REQ-025 ledger + REQ-026 reminders + REQ-027 cancellation as one notification subsystem): grepped `event_cancelled` across apps/bot/src -- exactly two hits, domain/notification.ts:21 (the NotificationKind union member REQ-025 itself pre-declared for this requirement) and handlers/event.ts:410 (the literal passed to sendLedgeredNotification). notifyNonWithdrawnRegistrants calls the identical, unmodified sendLedgeredNotification function REQ-026's reminder jobs already call -- confirmed by reading domain/notification.ts's export list and both call sites side by side; no parallel/bespoke send-and-log mechanism was introduced. My own scratch script's ledger query independently confirmed real rows physically written to the shared notification_ledger table with kind='event_cancelled' -- not a mock, not a parallel table. No integration gap found: REQ-027 is a straightforward third call site on REQ-025's single shared primitive, exactly as REQ-026 already was. 5. Confirmed full requirement scope: git diff --stat lists only the design-doc-listed files (domain/registration.ts, handlers/event.ts, handlers/event.db.test.ts (new), handlers/event.dispatch.test.ts (new), i18n/en.ts+ru.ts+types.ts, index.ts, the design doc, the test spec, ISS-0024, and this run's own handoffs/test-report) -- nothing stray. git grep for TODO/FIXME/XXX across the REQ-027 diff: zero matches. git status --porcelain clean before and after this handoff (my own scratch-rv-req027.ts script removed after use). 6. Filed-issue judgment: ISS-0024 (MINOR, filed by TEST-RUNNER this run) is a test-spec documentation completeness gap (the organizer-role/chapterId fixture step wasn't called out in the shared setup section) -- not a code defect, already worked around correctly by TEST-RUNNER's own fixture, and does not affect shipped correctness. ISS-0013 through ISS-0023 and ISS-0020 (MAJOR, REQ-018's staff.ts blocked-user gap) all pre-date this run and are explicitly out of scope per the task context. None of the filed issues should block this release. Overall: every independent check -- lint, build, the full 266-test suite from the repo root, my own AC1 fixture with a distinct 6/4/3 count combination, my own AC4 before/after row-level comparison, confirmation that domain/event.ts (cancelEvent) has literally zero diff, and the Phase 5 ledger-coherence grep -- agrees with all prior gates (CODE-DESIGNER/VALIDATOR, BACKEND-DEV, REVIEWER, SECURITY-REVIEWER, TEST-DESIGNER/VALIDATOR, TEST-RUNNER). No half-implemented scope, no stray TODOs, clean git tree, all design-doc-listed files present. This is the last requirement of Phase 5 -- REQ-025 (ledger), REQ-026 (reminders), and REQ-027 (cancellation) together form a coherent notification subsystem built on one shared send-once primitive with no parallel mechanism.
